civil3d-booster.name: Civil 3D Booster
civil3d-booster.description: Productivity toolkit for Civil 3D to automate surface labeling, alignment offsets, and pipe corridor editing.
civil3d-booster.author: EVLab Tools

autolisp-toolkit.name: AutoLISP Toolkit for Water Utilities
autolisp-toolkit.description: Collection of specialized AutoLISP routines to speed up pipe drafting and node numbering in AutoCAD.
autolisp-toolkit.author: EVLab Tools

gis-connector-plugin.name: CAD to Enterprise GIS Vector Connector
gis-connector-plugin.description: Bi-directional bridge plugin converting AutoCAD/Civil 3D utility vector drawings directly into enterprise ArcGIS/QGIS geodatabase features.
gis-connector-plugin.author: EVLab Tools

hec-ras-controller-plugin.name: HEC-RAS Controller Automation & Python Scripting Tool
hec-ras-controller-plugin.description: Automation script library and COM interface for batch running HEC-RAS 1D/2D models, Monte Carlo sensitivity runs, and GIS output exporting.

qgis-geoprocessing-python-plugin.name: QGIS GeoProcessing & Survey Data Import Python Plugin
qgis-geoprocessing-python-plugin.description: Custom PyQGIS plugin for direct import of total station field raw files, automated traverse plotting, and coordinate transformation.

bridge-section-property-calculator.name: Bridge Composite Section Property & Prestress Loss Calculator
bridge-section-property-calculator.description: Utility plugin for calculating composite section properties, cracked section properties, and prestress losses.

tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.name: Parametric Tunnel Alignment & Lining Generator Plugin
tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.description: Civil 3D / Revit plugin for automated generation of 3D parametric tunnel segment rings along complex 3D alignment profiles.
tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.author: EVLab Tools
